description: This file defines the configuration class 'LDAPAuthenticationPluginConfiguration' for the LDAP authentication plugin within the OrangeHRM project. It implements plugin, console, and scheduling interfaces to initialize LDAP settings, register LDAP synchronization commands, and schedule periodic LDAP sync jobs.

classes.name: LDAPAuthenticationPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class that integrates LDAP authentication into the OrangeHRM system, handling initialization, command registration, and scheduled LDAP sync jobs.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up LDAP logging and adds LDAP authentication provider if LDAP is enabled.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers LDAP synchronization command with the console.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules periodic LDAP sync based on configured sync interval.
